rationale: Dataset reconnaissance requires comprehensive assessment of five input tables. Plan: (1) load_tables to establish row and column counts; (2) schema_summary to produce data_contract.json documenting all column types; (3) missingness with all_columns scope to expose every null pattern (entirely-null dx3-dx5 columns, 10914-row null drg/mdc/poa groups); (4) duplicate_check on all candidate keys to verify claim_id, rx_claim_id, provider_npi uniqueness and assess adherence granularity; (5) date_ranges with consistency_checks to catch temporal anomalies (service_date_to before service_date_from, adjudication_date before service end); (6) join_check on all declared foreign keys to confirm referential integrity and expose known failures (pharmacy NPIs do not join to provider table); (7) write_report with cite_artifacts to trace every finding to source data.
